subject: Charged twice this month
body: I've been charged twice this month and I've sent 3 emails already. This is unacceptable.

subject: Dashboard returning 500 errors for the whole team
body: The dashboard has been returning 500 errors for our whole team since 9am. We can't open any reports and we have a client demo at 2pm today.

subject: Final warning before chargeback
body: If the duplicate charge isn't refunded by Friday I am filing a chargeback with my bank and handing this to my lawyer. Four emails and nobody has replied.

subject: Schedule exports to Google Drive

subject: Admin account possibly compromised
body: We think someone got into our admin account: there are two API keys none of us created and a login from a country we don't operate in. Please lock it down right away.

subject: CSV import fails at row 1,200
body: CSV import keeps failing at row 1,200 with 'invalid date format' even though every date is YYYY-MM-DD. Smaller files import fine. Tried three times.

subject: Invoice with VAT number
body: Can you send me the October invoice with our VAT number on it? Our finance team needs it for reconciliation.

subject: Password reset email never arrives
body: Password reset emails never arrive. I checked spam and tried four times today. I'm locked out.

subject: Webhook deliveries delayed
body: Webhook deliveries to our endpoint have been delayed by about 20 minutes since yesterday. Not blocking us, but noticeable.

subject: Why did our bill go up?
body: Why did our bill go up from $49 to $79? Nobody told us about any price change.

subject: Blank PDFs going to our clients
body: You pushed an update and now ALL our scheduled reports are emailing blank PDFs to our clients. This is embarrassing and we're losing clients over it. Fix it NOW.

subject: Date picker ignores week start
body: Small thing: the date picker shows Sunday as the first day of the week even though I set Monday in my preferences.

subject: Okta SSO support?
body: Is there any plan to support SSO with Okta? Our IT team is asking before we roll this out to 200 people.

subject: Search breaks on apostrophes
body: Search returns no results for any query containing an apostrophe, e.g. O'Brien. We tried wrapping it in quotes and escaping it with a backslash, same result.

subject: Extra seats bought by mistake
body: We accidentally bought 5 extra seats. Can we get a refund for those, or just downgrade?

subject: Dark mode
body: Honestly it's frustrating that there's still no dark mode. Every other tool we use has it.

subject: Android app crashes on launch
body: The mobile app crashes immediately on launch on Android 15 since today's update. We reinstalled, cleared the cache and rebooted, still crashes. Our field team can't log any visits.

subject: Add a view-only teammate
body: How do I add a new team member with view-only access?

subject: DPA before renewal

subject: Payment methods

body: Would love an API endpoint to bulk-update tags on records. Happy to beta test it!
